subject: PayVanta trial onboarding: commitment matrix & next steps
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: PayVanta trial onboarding: commitment matrix & next steps

Alex — great to meet today. Quick recap from our discovery + agreed next steps so we have one place to track ownership heading into the trial kickoff next week. Please review and confirm.

High-level objective
- Validate Redwood Inference can auto-scale to PayVanta’s peak checkout burst pattern while keeping 95th percentile latency under 250ms for single-turn generation calls.

Success criteria (you confirmed these on the call)
- Latency: p95 <= 250ms for your 512-token typical prompt workload
- Throughput: sustain 600 req/min for peak window without queueing errors
- Data controls: log retention policy in place; no customer PII persisted in logs beyond 7 days
- Integration: SDK-based inference integration in your dev/stage environment with sample workload and dashboard tracing enabled

Proposed trial plan & timeline
- Week 0 (next Mon): environment access + onboarding (Redwood private sandbox + API key)
- Week 1: baseline runs + initial tuning (batching/kv caching)
- Week 2: stress window simulation + SLA smoke tests
- Week 3: readout + decision (go/no-go to production rollout)

Action owners (initial)
- Redwood (Ben): trial coordination, environment setup, demo of tracing, provide trial commitment matrix (attached)
- Redwood (Priyom): technical enablement and runbook (KV cache hints, quantization recommendation)
- PayVanta (Alex): provide sample prompts, representative traffic pattern, sandbox access (VPN + service account)
- PayVanta (Dev/Infra): validate network egress rules and open ports for private deployment testing

Attachments included: trial-onboarding-commitment-matrix.xlsx (workstream + owner dates), sow-draft-v0.2.pdf (initial SOW for trial scope)

Please reply with any edits to the success criteria and confirm the name of the Dev/Infra contact who will set up network access. If all good, we’ll schedule the kickoff for next Monday 09:30 PT.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Thanks Ben — good recap. Confirming the success criteria look right. A few notes from our side:

- We’ll aim to provide a 48-hour rolling sample of production prompts by Friday EOD (examples + traffic slice).
- Our Dev/Infra lead for sandbox network setup will be Priya Nadarajan (pnadarajan@payvanta.com) — she can open a ticket for VPN/service account creation.
- For latency, p95 under 250ms is acceptable but we’d also like a note of expected cost delta if we push for p50 <= 120ms (rough ballpark).

Kickoff: Monday 09:30 PT works for us.

One request: can you include a single-sheet acceptance test we can run at the end of Week 2 so Product/Infra folks can validate quickly?

Appreciate the attachment — we’ll review and flag edits inside the spreadsheet.
